convert_figure_to_image: convert a matplotlib figure or list of figures to a numpy array in CHW format
prepare_video_tensor: convert a 5D video tensor from batch-time-channel-height-width to a 4D grid layout
create_image_grid: create a grid layout from a batch of images with configurable number of columns
convert_tensor_format: convert a numpy tensor between dimension formats like NCHW, HWC, or HW to HWC
test_tensorboard_utils: test the tensorboard utility functions for converting figures, videos, and tensors
